title: Haelan Capital Partners debuts; KKR launches Akrapoint Commercial Capital; PE bets on rail services
summary:

title: Alternative Views with Barings’s Stuart Mathieson
summary: In Alternative Views, Private Equity Wire® goes behind closed doors with those in the know to get the latest on private markets. In this episode we discuss sponsor-backed lending with Stuart Mathieson, head of European private finance at Barings.

title: Silver Lake takes legal action against Icahn and hedge funds over Endeavor feal
summary: Silver Lake has launched legal action against Carl Icahn and a group of hedge funds in Delaware, seeking to prevent them from using appraisal proceedings to pursue potential payouts linked to the PE firm's 2025 acquisition of Endeavor Group Holdings, according to a repot by Reuters.

title: Novo Advisors launches value creation practice for PE-backed companies
summary: Management consulting firm Novo Advisors has launched a new Value Creation practice aimed at helping private equity, venture capital and other investor-backed businesses improve financial performance and operational execution.

title: KKR targets Korea’s AI supply chain after record $3bn investment
summary: TOP STORY: KKR is looking to expand its investment activity in South Korea after deploying around $3bn in the country this year, with the private equity firm targeting opportunities created by the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence infrastructure, according to a report by Bloomberg.

title: Hg expands Anthropic partnership to deploy agentic AI across portfolio
summary: Private equity firm Hg is expanding its relationship with artificial intelligence company Anthropic as it seeks to deploy agentic AI capabilities across its portfolio and accelerate value creation at its software and services businesses.

title: Grant Thornton CEO defends Cinven ownership
summary: Grant Thornton UK chief executive Malcolm Gomersall has defended the accounting firm's private equity ownership, arguing that Cinven's investment has increased scrutiny of audit quality rather than undermining it, according top a report by the Financial Times.

title: Clearlake and Charlesbank to inject $175m into distressed Symplr
summary: Private equity firms Clearlake Capital Group and Charlesbank Capital Partners have agreed to provide around $175m of preferred equity to healthcare software provider Symplr as part of a restructuring designed to shore up the company's finances and push out debt maturities, according to a report by Bloomberg.
